title: Itô's formula for Lévy-Itô processes taking values in the dual of nuclear space
summary: Using the theory of stochastic integration in duals of nuclear spaces with respect to cylindrical martingale-valued measures, a vector-valued Itô formula is proved for generalized Itô processes defined with respect to these integrals. The abstract result is then applied to prove an Itô formula for Lévy-Itô processes defined with respect to Lévy processes taking values in the dual of a reflexive nuclear space.
